source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 共同擘画中美关系新篇章
topics.official_english: Jointly charting a new chapter in China-US relations
topics.why_hot: Top of the Baidu hot list; China-US relations is a high-stakes topic that draws broad public attention in both countries.
topics.share_angle: Explain what this diplomatic framing means in practice — tone, agenda, and what to watch next — while noting that the headline itself carries no policy details.

topics.official_english: WeChat rolls out two new features
topics.why_hot: WeChat is used by over a billion people, so any app update instantly affects daily communication habits.
topics.share_angle: Walk through what changed for ordinary users, and be explicit that the headline does not specify which two features — confirm details before describing them.

topics.chinese_topic: 今年中秋高端月饼礼盒卖不动了
topics.official_english: Premium mooncake gift boxes see sluggish sales this Mid-Autumn Festival
topics.why_hot: Mooncakes are a seasonal staple, and weak high-end sales are being read as a signal about consumer spending.
topics.share_angle: Use it to discuss changing gift-giving norms and cautious consumption, without extrapolating to the whole economy from one category.

topics.official_english: Muse reaches the top as Meta regains ground with AI agents
topics.why_hot: AI model rankings and the agent race are among the fastest-moving tech stories, with strong interest from developers and investors.
topics.share_angle: Frame it as part of the agent-competition narrative; flag that the headline alone does not name the ranking or benchmarks involved.

topics.chinese_topic: 金牌再+1！盛李豪王子菲夺金
topics.official_english: Another gold: Sheng Lihao and Wang Zifei take first place
topics.why_hot: Medal wins by Chinese athletes reliably top the charts and drive patriotic engagement.
topics.share_angle: Recap the result and the athletes' background; note that the headline does not state the event or competition, so verify before publishing.

topics.chinese_topic: 共赴技能之约 同筑匠心之基
topics.official_english: Coming together for skills, building a foundation of craftsmanship
topics.why_hot: Skills and vocational training campaigns resonate at a time of youth employment concerns and industrial upgrading.
topics.share_angle: Explain the skills-development push and why craftsmanship is being promoted, avoiding claims about specific programs not stated in the headline.

topics.chinese_topic: 多家民营银行5年期定期存款重上架

topics.why_hot: Deposit rates affect household savings directly, and product changes at private banks draw close attention from savers.
topics.share_angle: Discuss what returning long-term deposits may signal about funding needs and rates, without naming specific institutions or yields not in the headline.
